title: CITE-seq (cellular indexing of transcriptomes and epitopes by sequencing) of WT and RAS mutant specimens from acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients.
description: To understand the role of RAS mutations in AML, we performed CITE-seq on diagnosis specimens from WT and RAS mutant AML patients. Overall design: Cells were harvested from AML patients at diagnosis and subjected to CITE-seq analysis.
